batch_semantics: An adapter may use a documented public batch API for an equivalent operation; every output row is retained in the digest and the adapter declares batch_operations in metadata.

diagnostic_only_operations.rings: RDKit/CheMatic use the pinned RDKit ring-count model while CDK and Indigo expose SSSR counts; a mismatch is reported but is not a chemistry-accuracy verdict.

corpus_tiers.smoke: 24 checked-in stratified structures; verifies adapters and catches obvious regressions only.
corpus_tiers.claim: A frozen broad corpus plus adversarial structures, exact package hashes, a second host, and a separate peak-RSS lane are required before a published superiority claim.

acceptance.accuracy: No mismatch or unclassified error on the frozen supported corpus; unsupported rows do not count as wins.
acceptance.speed: At least 21 alternating blocks, every block faster, paired 95% speedup lower bound above 1.0, equivalent successful output, separate pipeline and prepared lanes.
acceptance.memory: Peak RSS is reported separately before any published superiority claim.
acceptance.claim_boundary: A pass is a win for the named operation, version, corpus, platform and artifact only; it is not universal superiority over CDK or Indigo.
